name: ae-control
description: Direct, guarded Adobe After Effects control for macOS via PID-targeted Apple Events.

interface.shortDescription: Control local After Effects compositions safely.
interface.longDescription: Targets multiple local After Effects projects by exact process ID without stealing window or keyboard focus. Inspects compositions, properties, layers, and executes guarded JSX automation.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my open After Effects composition.
Check open AE instance and take a snapshot of the composition.
